profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Riot Games

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
From July 2015 to December 2018, joined an established Media Systems team directly supporting Paul Allen as a Software Engineer. Developed media services and streaming software in an Agile environment.

In January 2019, promoted to Senior Software Engineer and joined the Enterprise Solutions (Business Applications) team, serving as Scrum Master and primarily responsible for technology infrastructure support, including the data warehouse and service integrations. With a focus on modern technology and Agile collaboration, currently implementing new workflow standards and processes for the team.

positions.title: Database Engineer
positions.description:
•	Monitored and supported databases in production for integrity of merge replication and synchronization
•	Developed and maintained daily ETL processes via SSIS packages, T-SQL SPROCs and C# services
•	Generated and installed SSL certificates for secure access to reporting services across database servers
•	Troubleshooted issues and concerns sent to the team from both internal and external customers
•	Provided detailed firewall redirection requirements for secure traversing across VLAN networks
•	Designed and deployed SSRS reports after collecting requirements from external and internal customers
•	Visualized and translated metrics that measure online success and increase checkout path conversion
•	Reviewed PCI compliance requirements and modified environment to meet compliance standards
•	Optimized queries, stored procedures, triggers, functions and views for application integration
•	Consumed RESTful APIs to collect data and metrics to transform them into meaningful dashboards
•	Created packages in SSIS and Sharepoint forms to reduce manual data manipulation for BI teams
•	Initiated and adhered to “gatekeeper” data policies to prevent process failures in production environments
•	Installed and configured settings for Oracle and Teradata database servers in both Windows and Linux
•	Documented processes and assisted PMs in translating technical requirements to other developers
•	Acted as TPM (technical program manager) and created functional specs for cross-department projects
•	Prepared for and led brown bags regarding database and overall stack structure for new team members
positions.insights: Transact-SQL (T-SQL), SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Data Program Manager
positions.description:
•	Originally hired as a Data Analyst in May 2009, promoted to Data Program Lead in January 2011, then promoted to Data Program Manager of the department in September 2011
•	Supervised and motivated staff of 25 including offshore Analysts
•	Tracked and evaluated eCommerce industry trends to identify potential new programs
•	Proposed and drove the level-of-effort research between onsite research analysts versus offshore analysts in order to restructure and reduce department costs 70% annually
•	Initiated and led market analysis projects to determine realistic income projections prior to launching new program specifications to senior management
•	Generated monthly dashboards and ad hoc reporting to provide visibility into client project growth and identified areas of improvement for eCommerce branding
•	Evaluated team’s skill sets to create and assign proper database access privileges
•	Launched new QA process eliminating missing client data uploads by suggesting primary key values across all files
•	Recruited new team members and assisted in other team interviews that built a solid workforce
•	Created new standards for identification of website ownership increasing offshore data entry rate by 20%
•	Led weekly conference calls with offshore team to ensure accuracy increasing from 93% to 96%
•	Developed complex MySQL queries automating 30% of a team monthly deliverable

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
•	Developed, maintained and modified complex queries as necessary with multiple temporary tables and nested joins to identify areas of focus for team efforts on a monthly basis
•	Defined measurement tools to capture success metrics on data migration between old and new products
•	Created stored procedures using T-SQL to validate inventoried XML data
•	Offered input and expertise in the creation of software taxonomy to assist business consumers
•	Mentored junior Researchers on data management efficiencies 
•	Managed and analyzed classification of 500,000+ software titles
•	Set and met deadlines to research and summarize 1,000+ various software titles within weekly sprints
•	Managed and motivated staff of three
